defs.def: a small stick made of wood or cardboard that is used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. 火柴

ex.s: When you struck the match to light your cigar I saw it was the face of the man wanted in Chicago.
ex.t: 当你划火柴点燃雪茄时，我看到了那张脸，正是芝加哥通缉犯的脸。

defs.def: a sports event where people or teams compete against each other 比赛；竞赛

ex.s: beat humans in international chess matches
ex.t: 在国际象棋比赛中击败人类。

ex.s: The possibility of entering into and losing such a match should concentrate the minds of computer scientists.
ex.t: 陷入并输掉这样一局棋的可能性，理应让计算机科学家集中注意力。

ex.s: If we are not careful, then, we could face a kind of global chess match against very determined, super intelligent machines whose objectives conflict with our own, with the real world as the chessboard.
ex.t: 如果我们不小心，那么，我们可能面临一种全球象棋比赛，对手是非常坚定、超级智能的机器，其目标与我们冲突，而真实世界就是棋盘。

ex.s: 35. —Going to watch the Women’s Volleyball Match on Wednesday?
ex.t: 35. — 周三要去看女子排球比赛吗？

ex.s: As darkness came over the field and the match ended, the goal keeper, Juan, walked over to me and said in a matter-of-fact way, “In your home, do you have a moon too?” I was surprised.
ex.t: 当夜幕笼罩球场、比赛结束，守门员胡安走到我面前，用一种就事论事的口气说：“在你们家，也有月亮吗？”我很惊讶。

ex.s: Even soccer fans tend to have a seat each; gone are the days of thousands standing to watch the match.
ex.t: 就连足球迷也倾向于每人有一个座位；成千上万人站着观看比赛的日子一去不复返了。

ex.s: What does the woman think of the match?
ex.t: 那位女士觉得这场比赛怎么样？

ex.s: What does the woman think of the match?
ex.t: 那位女士觉得这场比赛怎么样？

ex.s: Next, the Chinese team defeated the Netherlands in the semifinal matches, having lost to them in the preliminaries.
ex.t: 接着，中国队在半决赛中击败了荷兰队，此前她们在预赛中还输给过对方。

ex.s: Despite reaching the quarterfinals as the fourth team in the group, with just two wins in preliminary matches, they were not going to give up.
ex.t: 尽管作为小组第四名进入了四分之一决赛，在预赛中只赢了两场比赛，但他们并没有打算放弃。

ex.s: I’m crazy about basketball, and pretty good at it too, which is probably why I was so mad when we lost our last match.
ex.t: 我痴迷于篮球，而且打得相当好，这可能就是为什么上次比赛我们输了时我那么生气。

defs.def: a person who is equal to sb else in strength, skill, intelligence, etc. 敌手；旗鼓相当的人
a person or thing that combines well with sb/sth else 相配的人（或物）；般配的人（或物）

ex.s: The trailer even has matching carpet and curtains.
ex.t: 这辆拖车甚至配有相配的地毯和窗帘。

defs.def: a thing that looks exactly the same as or very similar to sth else 相同的东西；非常相似的东西
a marriage or a marriage partner 婚姻；配偶
if two things match, or if one thing matches another, they have the same colour, pattern, or style and therefore look attractive together 般配；相配
if two things match or if one thing matches another, they are the same or very similar 相同；相似；相一致

ex.s: Led by the concept of “right plant, right place,” they match plants that enjoy the same soil, sun and weather conditions, and arrange them according to their patterns of growth.
ex.t: 在“合适的植物，合适的位置”这一理念引领下，他们把喜好相同土壤、阳光和天气条件的植物搭配在一起，并按其生长模式排列。

ex.s: The call to “know yourself” has been there since ancient times, but our sense of self doesn’t always match what others perceive.
ex.t: “认识你自己”的号召自古就有，但我们对自己的认知并不总是与他人对我们的看法一致。

defs.def: to find sb/sth that goes together with or is connected with another person or thing 找相称（或相关）的人（或物）；配对

ex.s: The very best communicators are those who know how to adjust their language to match their audience.
ex.t: 最好的沟通者是那些知道如何根据读者调整语言的人。

ex.s: Pairs are matched by languages of interest and proficiency levels.
ex.t: 配对根据兴趣语言和熟练程度进行匹配。

ex.s: Since there are many factors involved in the pairing process, not all students who sign up will be matched with a partner and be able to register for the programme.
ex.t: 由于配对过程中涉及许多因素，并非所有报名的学生都能匹配到搭档并注册该项目。

ex.s: Above all, I hoped he wouldn't assign me to work with the fiercely competitive, extremely serious fellow who always wore dark clothes and apparently had a personality to match.
ex.t: 最重要的是，我希望他不会把我分配给那个竞争心极强、极其严肃、总是穿深色衣服、而且显然性格也与之相称的家伙。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。

defs.def: to be as good, interesting, successful, etc. as sb/sth else 与 … 相匹敌；和 … 不相上下

ex.s: Match the routes to the explorers.] (1 Ferdinand Magellan (1480-1521) was a Portuguese explorer who sailed west from Spain across the Atlantic and Pacific oceans in search of a westward route to the Spice Islands (now part of Indonesia).
ex.t: 将路线与探险家匹配。费迪南德·麦哲伦（1480-1521）是一位葡萄牙探险家，他从西班牙向西横渡大西洋和太平洋，寻找前往香料群岛（现属印度尼西亚）的西行路线。

ex.s: It had simple words and colorful pictures—a perfect match for his age.
ex.t: 它有简单的文字和彩色的图画——正适合他的年龄。

ex.s: Participants were randomly divided into two groups: the “beauty” group was asked to actively consider and then rate the beauty of each object they viewed, while the control group just matched a line drawing of the object with the artwork itself.
ex.t: 参与者被随机分为两组：“美”组被要求主动思考并为所看到的每件物品的美打分，而对照组只是将物品的线描图与艺术品本身进行匹配。

defs.def: to make sth the same or better than sth else 使等同于；使优于
to provide sth that is suitable for or enough for a particular situation 适应；满足
